import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/**
 * A bare self-edge is a loop back to the signature node; an aliased one is
 * a recursive call.
 *
 * Runs proc Count: `POST /api/count` on http server web-api.
 */
export async function count(args: { readonly n: number; readonly acc: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/count", {
    "n": $encInt(args.n),
    "acc": $encInt(args.acc),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Fib: `GET /api/fib` on http server web-api. */
export async function fib(args: { readonly n: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/api/fib", {
    "n": $encInt(args.n),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_CountArgs(x: $t.CountArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "n": $encInt(x.n),
    "acc": $encInt(x.acc),
  };
}

export function $dec_CountArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.CountArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    n: $decInt($field(o, "n", at), at + ".n"),
    acc: $decInt($field(o, "acc", at), at + ".acc"),
  };
}

export function $enc_FibArgs(x: $t.FibArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "n": $encInt(x.n),
  };
}

export function $dec_FibArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.FibArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);

  };

// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * A bare self-edge is a loop back to the signature node; an aliased one is
 * a recursive call.
 *
 * Runs proc Count through count (`POST /api/count` on http server web-api):
 * with args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useCount(args?: { readonly n: number; readonly acc: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly n: number; readonly acc: number }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.count, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Fib through fib (`GET /api/fib` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useFib(args?: { readonly n: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly n: number }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.fib, args, opts);
}
